newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey to buy 100,000 T Argentine milling wheat.
newsitem.headline: Turkey to buy 100,000 T Argentine milling wheat.

text.p: Turkey will import 100,000 tonnes of red milling wheat from Argentine under a tender by the state grain board TMO which was finalised earlier in the day, an official said on Friday.
TMO awarded the tender, worth a total of around $29 million, to three companies to import 100,000 tonnes of red and 50,000 tonnes of white milling wheat.
The official said the white milling wheat would be imported from the U.S., Canada or Australia.
All of the purchases would be under a three-year credit basis and the loading would be made in January, he said.

Half of the 100,000 tonnes of the red milling wheat will be bought from Eksim foreign trade firm representing Farm Trading and the other half from Romak. The white milling wheat will be bought from Glencore.
Bids from 12 companies were received in the tender.

The TMO has been authorised by the government to import up to 500,000 tonnes of wheat to curb local wheat and bread prices which rose about 30 percent in November as Turkey blocked imports from the United States for inspections against crop disease for weeks.
Turkey and the U.S. reached an agreement earlier this month on the issue.

The TMO also began selling wheat to local millers from its own stocks in November to halt the price increases after which bread prices fell to 15,000 lira from around 18,000-20,000 lira in some parts of the country.
